name: apichap AI Coding Gateway default rules
description: Starter rules, one group per policy. Allow everyday coding work, block destructive or risky actions. Anything no rule allows is denied. A matching deny rule always wins.

groups.title: The agent is not allowed to delete files
groups.description: Deleting files and folders is not allowed. Deleting through git is covered by the git group below.

deny.note: Block file deletions in Codex patches, including when an allow rule covers the path.
Delete files or folders with rm.
rm called by its full path
Remove directories with the Windows rd command.
Delete files with the Windows del command.
Delete files with the Windows erase command.
Delete files or folders with PowerShell.

groups.title: The agent is not allowed to read or change secret files
groups.description: .env files, SSH keys, cloud credentials and certificates contain secrets. This applies to the file tools and to shell commands.

groups.title: The agent is not allowed to throw away work in git
groups.description: Commands that discard uncommitted changes, delete branches or stashes, or rewrite history cannot be undone.

deny.note: force-deletes a branch without merge check
destroys the history needed to recover work
destroys the history needed to recover work

groups.title: The agent is not allowed to force-push or delete remote branches
groups.description: Normal pushes are fine. Overwriting or deleting what is on the remote is not allowed.

deny.note: a mirror push overwrites the remote

groups.title: The agent is not allowed to change git settings or skip git hooks
groups.description: Git settings and aliases can make git run any program, and --no-verify skips the checks your hooks run.

deny.note: per-command git config can run arbitrary programs
git aliases can run arbitrary commands
can make git run arbitrary programs
runs arbitrary commands in every submodule

groups.title: The agent is not allowed to run inline or downloaded code
groups.description: Code passed on the command line or piped into a shell runs without anyone seeing it. Put it in a script file in the project instead.

deny.note: Invoke-Expression runs a string as code
Invoke-Expression runs a string as code
can make every node process load extra code

groups.title: The agent is not allowed to use admin rights or change the machine
groups.description: No sudo, no disk formatting, no shutdown or reboot, no world-writable permissions.

groups.title: The agent is not allowed to publish packages
groups.description: Publishing a package makes it public and usually cannot be undone.

deny.note: Publish a package to the npm registry.

groups.title: The agent is not allowed to change the gateway or agent hook settings
groups.description: Otherwise the agent could switch the gateway off, allow its own calls or remove the hooks. Managing the gateway is for you, not the agent.

groups.title: The agent is allowed to read and search files only inside the current project and Claude´s home holder
groups.description: Reading other projects, the home folder or system files is denied until you allow it. Shell commands like cat are not path-checked.

groups.title: The agent is allowed to change files only inside the current project
groups.description: Creating and editing files elsewhere is denied until you allow it. Claude Code's scratchpad, plan and memory files are included.
